author: ShinobiPig
body: I try to log into Avic.us, a server I've played for years, as a matter of fact, the first server I've been on; what I see is "Ban Evasion (IXpig)". I have not evaded a ban and I am also the owner of this account. I have been falsely accused by Minerlord55 as of December 31st 2015. I am awaiting an apology from avicus and a of course an unbanning of my account.

title: What is going on?

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body: Your IP links directly to IXpig, therefore you have some sort of a relation to this account. Do you have a friend or a sibling? Perhaps you accessed Avicus via your school computer?

replies.author: ShinobiPig
replies.body: No, IXpig is my cousin. We don't live in the same house so I don't know how our IPs are linked.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Yes, that seems likely. Your latest IPs only match between 6-12%. Due to this, I will accept your appeal. Make sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and enjoy the server!

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
